rationale: Kimi-K2.6 became boundary-censored at execution_server checkpoint 4, leaving only two recursive feedback updates. DeepSeek-v4-flash is already validated on the same ModelArts MaaS provider and has no execution_server treatment output. This calibration changes only the model and prospectively searches for a naturally completed prefix of at least four checkpoints before any recursive-manager contrast is run.

candidates.reason: A six-checkpoint real coding workflow can expose three to five recursive manager updates if the no-transfer baseline remains naturally completable.

prefix_selection_rule.select: Choose the longest prefix k for which every checkpoint 1 through k has no infrastructure failure, every checkpoint explicitly completes before action 32, and checkpoint k normalized Core and all-test scores are each at least 0.50.
prefix_selection_rule.headroom: The terminal checkpoint must fail at least one collected test or one Core test. If it is perfect, step back to the longest earlier qualifying non-perfect checkpoint.
prefix_selection_rule.abandon: If no prefix of at least 4 qualifies, do not run the DeepSeek recursive manager contrast on execution_server.

formal_if_valid.replication_policy: If treatment-control all-test gaps are negative at both final checkpoints, add two identical independent replicates. Otherwise stop this model-task-provider pair.
